verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents its own dev mode: a one-command local `start-dev` container with bootstrap admin credentials. It also offers realms as isolated tenants and realm JSON import/export, so you can stand up a separate test instance or realm seeded with configuration instead of touching production. However, it has no first-class sandbox or staging concept, and community reports say config lives in the database with no supported way to test changes and promote them to production, while keeping a JSON-loaded realm in sync afterward is hard. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test-mode feature, a supported test-to-production promotion workflow, test-data seeding or masking guidance, and hands-on corroboration of an isolated testing workflow.
